rulePack.name: Malaysian employment-law thresholds (sources captured, values pending human sign-off)
rulePack.notes: Instruments registered with official PDF hashes. Proposed numeric values are in governance/MY_STAT_S04_EMPLOYMENT_LAW_INTAKE.md awaiting named HUMAN_REVIEW_OF_OFFICIAL_PDF sign-off. employment_law_rules stays empty and this pack is not approved until that sign-off + S04 implementation — no payroll can reach it.

sources.issuer: Jabatan Tenaga Kerja Semenanjung Malaysia (JTKSM) / Attorney General's Chambers
sources.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) — JTKSM reprint November 2023
sources.note: Official JTKSM-hosted reprint (1,500,502 bytes) retrieved 2026-08-08. AGC act-detail page is index-only. Weekly hours must be read from the post-A1651 text (45, not the pre-amendment 48). First Schedule para 1A ceiling is P.U.(A) 262/2022 as commenced by P.U.(A) 273/2022. Proposed values in MY_STAT_S04_EMPLOYMENT_LAW_INTAKE.md — not approved until human sign-off.

sources.title: Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980
sources.note: Official JTKSM PDF (61,940 bytes) retrieved 2026-08-08. Reg. 2 sets the s.60A(4)(a) monthly OT limit at 104 hours. Proposed value in MY_STAT_S04_EMPLOYMENT_LAW_INTAKE.md — not approved until human sign-off.

sources.issuer: Ministry of Human Resources / Attorney General's Chambers
sources.title: Minimum Wages Order 2024
sources.note: Official MOHR gazette PDF (277,076 bytes) retrieved 2026-08-08. RM1,700 nationwide for covered private employers from 2025-08-01 (earlier path for ≥5 employees from 2025-02-01). For pack effectiveFrom 2026-01-01 the proposed floor is 170000 sen. AGC index: https://lom.agc.gov.my/act-view.php?type=pua&no=P.U.+%28A%29+376%2F2024&status=PRINCIPAL. Proposed value in MY_STAT_S04_EMPLOYMENT_LAW_INTAKE.md — not approved until human sign-off.
